description: This file defines the internal class WorkItemGroup which manages batching and scheduling of work items (tasks) within the Orleans Runtime, specifically related to grain activation task scheduling and execution.

classes.name: WorkItemGroup
classes.description: A class responsible for managing a group of work items/tasks associated with a specific grain context, including scheduling, execution, and queuing of tasks within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: EnqueueTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the work item queue and schedules execution if necessary.

methods.name: Execute
methods.description: Processes and executes queued tasks sequentially, managing the execution context and timing.

methods.name: DumpStatus
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the current status of the work item group, including queued items and execution info.

methods.name: QueueAction
methods.description: Queues an action to the task scheduler for execution.

methods.name: QueueTask
methods.description: Starts a task using this work item group's scheduler.
